description: Kept the sixteen bars until the parts are out.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Set the week, and kept the book shut on the total.
name: John Heminges

description: Named the dark Monday and the days he shares, and would not guess a sum.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Spoke on you, and did not have the tally closed.
name: Will Kemp

description: Confirmed the days he plays, and refused a sum.
name: William Shakespeare
